name: Tokyo-Big-Sight
tagline: Tokyo in 32 minutes and Otemachi in 33 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 33 minutes to Otemachi, 46 minutes to Shinjuku, 45 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 5.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 5.8 m to 8.4 m, a difference of 2.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 pharmacy. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 癌研有明病院, about 573 m away and フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 1598 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Yurikamome. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.
